scanNote:
8-UNITNING TO'RTINChI BETI (57-bet). O'ng yarmi PUShTI-SHAFTOLI fonda, yirtiq qog'oz chegarasi.

Yuqorida o'ngda 'A Brush with Danger' va BINAFShA yorliqda oq '8'.

CHAP USTUN:
13) 'Match the items in column A to those in column B, then say which action happened first.'
   A (pushti quti): Tracy served dinner ... / After the film had ended ... / She had read the book several times ... / When they arrived at the theatre ... / Paula had already finished tidying her room ...
   B (oq quti): Colin left the cinema. / after all her guests had arrived. / the play had already started. / by the time her mother came home from work. / before she understood it.
14) 'Join the sentences using the word(s) in brackets and the past perfect simple, as in the example.'
   1 Jim cast his fishing line into the water. His boat began rocking from side to side. (just, when) → Ko'k qiya: 'Jim HAD JUST CAST his fishing line into the water WHEN his boat began rocking from side to side.'
   2 We played Monopoly. We finished dinner. (after)
   3 Ann got into the shower. The doorbell rang. (just, when)
   4 I didn't go to sleep. I finished the book. (until)
   5 Kirsty spoke to George several times. He asked her out to dinner. (before)
   6 The train left. We arrived at the station. (already, by the time)
   7 I prepared the meal. My guests called to say they couldn't come. (already, when)
   8 Paula went to bed. Her guests left. (as soon as)
15) 'Look at the pictures and compare the two sentences. Which sentence includes a finished action? Which includes an action in progress?'
   IKKI SURAT: A - oshxonada ikki erkak ovqat pishirmoqda; B - stol atrofida to'rt erkak qadah ko'tarib, ovqat tayyor.
   A: 'They WERE COOKING dinner at 7 o'clock yesterday.' B: 'They HAD COOKED dinner before their guests arrived.'
• OCh KO'K quti, oq katta harflar 'Past Continuous vs Past Perfect Simple': 'We use the PAST CONTINUOUS for an action which was IN PROGRESS at a specific time in the past. We use the PAST PERFECT for an action which HAD FINISHED in the past before another action happened.'

O'NG USTUN:
16) 'Look at the pictures, then put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense.' OLTI SURAT (fotolar, oq qayd yorliqlari bilan):
   1 vayron bo'lgan uy (bo'ron) - 'When we returned, we found the hurricane ...... (destroy) our house.'
   2 zinada o'tirgan ikki qiz - 'When Cath got home, her daughters ...... (wait) for her on the steps.'
   3 quyosh botishida velosipedli odam silueti - 'When Mary reached the top of the hill, the sun ...... (set).'
   4 uy devorini bo'yayotgan ishchi - 'When we went to see the new house, the painters ...... (paint) the outside.'
   5 qog'oz ushlab norozi erkak - 'When Jeff got back to his car, he discovered that a traffic warden ...... (leave) him a parking ticket.'
   6 stolda uxlab qolgan qiz - 'Before the lesson ended, Kerry ...... (fall asleep).'
17) 'Write three things you had done before you had lunch yesterday, and three things you hadn't done.' Ko'k qiya: 'I had done my shopping before I had lunch yesterday.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '57'.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the items in column A to those in column B, then say which action happened first.
exercises.instructionUz: A ustundagi bandlarni B ustundagilarga moslang, so'ng qaysi harakat oldin bo'lganini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh JUFTLIK - QAYSI OLDIN?

  1 Tracy served dinner after all
    her guests had arrived.
    → OLDIN: mehmonlar keldi
  2 After the film had ended, Colin
    left the cinema.
    → OLDIN: film tugadi
  3 She had read the book several
    times before she understood it.
    → OLDIN: bir necha marta o'qidi
  4 When they arrived at the
    theatre, the play had already
    started.
    → OLDIN: spektakl boshlandi
  5 Paula had already finished
    tidying her room by the time
    her mother came home from work.
    → OLDIN: xonani yig'ishtirdi


⚠ QOIDA:

  PAST PERFECT = OLDINGI voqea
  (har doim!)


⚠ 'TO SERVE DINNER':

  = kechki ovqatni tortmoq.


⚠ 'BY THE TIME':

  = ... paytga kelib.
  ⚠ 'by the time her mother came
  home' = onasi kelgan paytga kelib.

pairs.right: after all her guests had arrived.

pairs.left: She had read the book several times ...
pairs.leftUz: U kitobni bir necha marta o'qigan edi ...
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ OLDIN: bir necha marta o'qidi (had read).

pairs.left: When they arrived at the theatre ...
Paula had already finished tidying her room ...
pairs.right: by the time her mother came home from work.

exercises.instructionEn: Join the sentences using the word(s) in brackets and the past perfect simple, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni qavsdagi so'z(lar) va past perfect simple yordamida birlashtiring, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Jim HAD JUST CAST his fishing line
   into the water WHEN his boat began
   rocking from side to side.'


⚠ QOIDA:

  Ikki gapdan OLDINGI voqeani
  aniqlang → u PAST PERFECT.
  Bog'lovchi so'z ikki gapni ulaydi.


TO'LIQ JAVOBLAR:

  2 We played Monopoly AFTER we HAD
    FINISHED dinner.
  3 Ann HAD JUST GOT into the shower
    WHEN the doorbell rang.
  4 I didn't go to sleep UNTIL I HAD
    FINISHED the book.
  5 Kirsty HAD SPOKEN to George
    several times BEFORE he asked
    her out to dinner.
  6 The train HAD ALREADY LEFT BY THE
    TIME we arrived at the station.
  7 I HAD ALREADY PREPARED the meal
    WHEN my guests called to say
    they couldn't come.
  8 Paula went to bed AS SOON AS her
    guests HAD LEFT.


⚠ 'JUST' va 'ALREADY' O'RNI:

  'had JUST cast', 'had ALREADY
  left' - 'had' va 3-shakl ORASIDA.


⚠ 'UNTIL' BILAN:

  "I didn't go to sleep UNTIL I had
  finished" = tugatmagunimcha
  uxlamadim.


⚠ 'TO ASK SB OUT':

  = uchrashuvga taklif qilmoq.


⚠ 'MONOPOLY':

  Stol o'yini nomi.
exercises.exampleEn: Jim had just cast his fishing line into the water when his boat began rocking from side to side.
exercises.exampleUz: Jim qarmoq ipini suvga endigina tashlagan edi, qayig'i chayqala boshladi.
modelAnswers: We played Monopoly after we had finished dinner.
Ann had just got into the shower when the doorbell rang.
I didn't go to sleep until I had finished the book.
Kirsty had spoken to George several times before he asked her out to dinner.
The train had already left by the time we arrived at the station.
I had already prepared the meal when my guests called to say they couldn't come.
Paula went to bed as soon as her guests had left.
modelAnswersUz: Kechki ovqatni tugatgandan keyin Monopoliya o'ynadik.
Ann dushga endigina kirgan edi, eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringladi.
Kirsty George bilan bir necha marta gaplashgan edi, keyin u uni kechki ovqatga taklif qildi.
Biz bekatga yetib borgan paytga kelib poyezd allaqachon ketgan edi.
Mehmonlarim kela olmasligini aytib qo'ng'iroq qilganda men ovqatni allaqachon tayyorlab bo'lgan edim.
Mehmonlari ketishi bilanoq Paula uxlashga yotdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and compare the two sentences. Which sentence includes a finished action? Which includes an action in progress?
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga qarab ikki gapni solishtiring. Qaysi gapda tugagan harakat bor? Qaysisida davom etayotgan harakat?
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI SURAT, IKKI ZAMON.

  A: 'They WERE COOKING dinner at 7
     o'clock yesterday.'
     → PAST CONTINUOUS - kecha soat
       7 da JARAYoNDA edi (surat:
       pishirishyapti)

  B: 'They HAD COOKED dinner before
     their guests arrived.'
     → PAST PERFECT - mehmonlar
       kelishidan OLDIN TUGAGAN
       (surat: ovqat tayyor, stolda)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAST CONTINUOUS vs PAST PERFECT ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  PAST CONTINUOUS (was/were + -ing):
    o'tmishdagi ANIQ VAQTDA DAVOM
    ETAYoTGAN harakat
    'at 7 o'clock', 'when I came in'

  PAST PERFECT (had + 3-shakl):
    boshqa voqeadan OLDIN TUGAGAN
    harakat
    'before the guests arrived'


⚠ TAQQOSLASh:

  'When I arrived, they WERE HAVING
   dinner.' - men kelganimda
   ovqatlanishayotgan edi (jarayon)
  'When I arrived, they HAD HAD
   dinner.' - men kelganimda
   ovqatlanib bo'lgan edi (tugagan)


⚠ 'IN PROGRESS':

  = jarayonda, davom etayotgan.

items.textEn: A: They were cooking dinner at 7 o'clock yesterday.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'WERE COOKING' - past continuous: soat 7 da
JARAYoNDA edi.

items.textEn: B: They had cooked dinner before their guests arrived.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'HAD COOKED' - past perfect: mehmonlar
kelishidan OLDIN TUGAGAN.

points.en: We use the past continuous for an action which was in progress at a specific time in the past.
points.uz: Past continuous ni o'tmishdagi aniq vaqtda davom etayotgan harakat uchun ishlatamiz.

points.en: We use the past perfect for an action which had finished in the past before another action happened.
points.uz: Past perfect ni o'tmishda boshqa harakat bo'lishidan oldin tugagan harakat uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ had + 3-ShAKL.
⚠ 'before their guests arrived' - boshqa harakat.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures, then put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense.
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga qarang, so'ng qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
SURAT HAL QILADI: TUGAGANMI yoki
DAVOM ETAYoTGANMI?


JAVOBLAR:

  1 the hurricane HAD DESTROYED our
    house
    (surat: uy VAYRON - tugagan)
  2 her daughters WERE WAITING for
    her on the steps
    (surat: qizlar zinada O'TIRIBDI -
     davom etyapti)
  3 the sun WAS SETTING
    (surat: quyosh BOTAYoTIR - davom
     etyapti)
  4 the painters WERE PAINTING the
    outside
    (surat: ishchi BO'YaYaPTI - davom
     etyapti)
  5 a traffic warden HAD LEFT him a
    parking ticket
    (surat: jarima QOG'OZI qo'lida -
     tugagan)
  6 Kerry HAD FALLEN ASLEEP
    (surat: qiz UXLAB QOLGAN -
     tugagan)


⚠ 'A HURRICANE':

  = dovul, kuchli bo'ron.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈhʌrɪkən/.


⚠ 'TO DESTROY':

  = vayron qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'destruction' = vayronagarchilik.


⚠ 'THE SUN SETS':

  = quyosh botadi.
  ⚠ 'sunset' = quyosh botishi;
  'sunrise' = quyosh chiqishi.
  ⚠ set - set - set.


⚠ 'A TRAFFIC WARDEN':

  = yo'l harakati nazoratchisi
  (parkovka jarimasi yozadi).
  ⚠ 'a parking ticket' = parkovka
  jarimasi.


⚠ 'TO FALL ASLEEP':

  = uxlab qolmoq.
  ⚠ fall - fell - FALLEN.
  ⚠ 'asleep' = uxlayotgan.

items.textEn: 1 When we returned, we found the hurricane ___ (destroy) our house.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Qaytganimizda uy ALLAQAChON vayron edi →
PAST PERFECT.

items.textEn: 2 When Cath got home, her daughters ___ (wait) for her on the steps.
items.hintUz: suratda qizlar zinada o'tiribdi - davom etyapti
items.whyUz:
⚠ U kelganida qizlar KUTAYoTGAN edi →
PAST CONTINUOUS.

items.textEn: 3 When Mary reached the top of the hill, the sun ___ (set).
4 When we went to see the new house, the painters ___ (paint) the outside.
5 When Jeff got back to his car, he discovered that a traffic warden ___ (leave) him a parking ticket.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Jarima ALLAQAChON qoldirilgan edi →
PAST PERFECT.
⚠ leave - left - LEFT.

items.textEn: 6 Before the lesson ended, Kerry ___ (fall asleep).
items.whyUz:
⚠ Dars tugashidan OLDIN uxlab qolgan edi →
PAST PERFECT.
⚠ fall - fell - FALLEN.

exercises.instructionEn: Write three things you had done before you had lunch yesterday, and three things you hadn't done.
exercises.instructionUz: Kecha tushlikdan oldin qilgan uchta ishingizni va qilmagan uchta ishingizni yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'I had done my shopping before I
   had lunch yesterday.'


⚠ QOLIPLAR:

  I HAD + 3-shakl ... before I had
  lunch yesterday.
  I HADN'T + 3-shakl ... before I
  had lunch yesterday.


⚠ 'HAD LUNCH' - PAST SIMPLE:

  'before I HAD lunch' - bu yerda
  'had' = 'have' ning o'tgan zamoni
  (tushlik qildim), past perfect
  EMAS.
  ⚠ 'I had done ... before I had
  lunch' - birinchi 'had' yordamchi,
  ikkinchi 'had' asosiy fe'l.
exercises.exampleEn: I had done my shopping before I had lunch yesterday.
exercises.exampleUz: Kecha tushlikdan oldin xaridimni qilib bo'lgan edim.
modelAnswers: I had done my shopping before I had lunch yesterday.
I had answered my emails before I had lunch yesterday.
I had cleaned the kitchen before I had lunch yesterday.
I hadn't finished my homework before I had lunch yesterday.
I hadn't phoned my grandmother before I had lunch yesterday.
I hadn't watered the plants before I had lunch yesterday.
modelAnswersUz: Kecha tushlikdan oldin xaridimni qilib bo'lgan edim.
Kecha tushlikdan oldin xatlarimga javob bergan edim.
Kecha tushlikdan oldin oshxonani tozalagan edim.
Kecha tushlikdan oldin uy vazifamni tugatmagan edim.
Kecha tushlikdan oldin buvimga qo'ng'iroq qilmagan edim.
Kecha tushlikdan oldin gullarni sug'ormagan edim.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Past perfect va past continuous qoliplari.

patterns.exampleEn: The train had already left by the time we arrived at the station.
patterns.exampleUz: Biz bekatga yetib borgan paytga kelib poyezd allaqachon ketgan edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'by the time' + past simple; asosiy gap past
perfect.

patterns.formula: [Ega] + PAST SIMPLE as soon as [ega] had + 3-ShAKL.
patterns.exampleEn: Paula went to bed as soon as her guests had left.
patterns.exampleUz: Mehmonlari ketishi bilanoq Paula uxlashga yotdi.

patterns.exampleEn: When Cath got home, her daughters were waiting for her.
patterns.exampleUz: Cath uyga kelganida qizlari uni kutayotgan edi.

patterns.exampleEn: When we returned, the hurricane had destroyed our house.
patterns.exampleUz: Qaytganimizda dovul uyimizni vayron qilgan edi.

groups.explanationUz: Betdagi 'asleep' shu qoidadan; bunday sifatlar otdan OLDIN turmaydi.
